```{r}
#| include: false
data(airquality)

```
## Airquality Data Exploration

### Missing Values


```{r}
#| echo: false 
missingvalues<- airquality[!complete.cases(airquality), ]
missingvalues

```

```{r}
#| echo: false 
Temperature<- airquality$Temp
Ozonelevel <- airquality$Ozone


```

## Summary statistics

### Temperature statistics


```{r}
#| echo: false
tempmean <-mean(Temperature, na.rm=TRUE)
tempsd <- sd(Temperature, na.rm=TRUE)
tempmin<- min(Temperature, na.rm=TRUE)
tempmax<- max(Temperature, na.rm=TRUE)
TempStats<-c(tempmean, tempsd, tempmin,tempmax)
TempStats

```

### Ozone level statistics
```{r}
#| echo: false
Ozonemean <-mean(Ozonelevel, na.rm=TRUE)
Ozonesd <- sd(Ozonelevel, na.rm=TRUE)
Ozonemin<- min(Ozonelevel, na.rm=TRUE)
Ozonemax<- max(Ozonelevel, na.rm=TRUE)
OzoneStats<-c(Ozonemean, Ozonesd, Ozonemin,Ozonemax)
OzoneStats 
```
